rows.grounds: locative of place indicating where the extracted element is to be placed
vocative epithet addressing the recipient of the instruction
gerund indicating prior action of drawing out the śiva-seed mentioned in context
vocative epithet addressing the goddess or practitioner

items.question: What locus and addressee are specified for the placement of the extracted śiva-seed?
premises: The śiva-seed has been extracted as a prior action.
The heart-lotus is named as the locus of placement.
The instruction is addressed to one called delighter-of-shiva and pure-smiled-one.
items.inference: The extracted śiva-seed is to be placed in the heart-lotus, as directed to the addressed recipient.
uncertainties: The precise referent of the vocative epithets rañjitaśivā and śucismite is not explicitly identified in this verse.
items.plain_english: O delighter of Shiva, O pure-smiled one, having extracted it, place it in the heart-lotus.
